name: agent-recall
description: Send a Recall.ai bot into a Zoom/Meet/Teams call, then fetch a speaker-labelled transcript. Explicit by design: only joins meeting URLs passed in, no calendar scanning.

recall_api_key.title: Recall.ai API key
recall_api_key.description: From https://<region>.recall.ai/dashboard/developers/api-keys — region-scoped, so it must match the region below.

recall_region.title: Recall.ai region
recall_region.description: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1 or ap-northeast-1. Must match the dashboard the key came from.
